name: Mio Akisha
source:
Mio is a top researcher at A.S.D.U SEC.
She was a child prodigy with extreme levels of intellect and her mysterious aura hypnotizes many who meet her.

Mio has an immense interest in space and discovered gravitons, which aided in the launch of Athirem.
When she uncovers the dark secrets her life is put in serious danger and fate intertwines with Rei...
